static_traits.name: Chen Simin
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的家人和朋友可倾诉,但not完全理解其求职困境;Unemployment压力导致与家人朋友Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without类似心理问题;此前not yet接受心理治疗;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性较好;能识do not并讨论自身认知模式;配合度高,Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管拥有Master's degree,但我相信自己永远without法获得一份'正经'Work,这种信念引发了without望和despair感.
basic_info.core_demands: 由于资历仍without法获得Work显著影响心理健康与整体人生观,寻求咨询支持.
growth_experiences: 完成Master's degree后开始求职,求职过程屡遭拒绝或without回复,压力显著升高并引发经济困难;随着时间推移,问题加剧,Decreased self-confidence;在人际方面,Unemployment带来与家人朋友的Relationship tension;在日常生活上,求职not确定性打乱作息并导致Sleep disorder.来访者为改善现状曾多次修订简历,进行人脉拓展,寻求职业建议,但负性信念仍然持续.

special_situations.event: 在投递岗位后收到拒信或not yet被回复
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not获得正面反馈或录用,就证明I am not good enough,且永远找not到'正经Work'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Revises resume, expands network, seeks career advice, strengthens interview preparation

special_situations.event: 收到面试邀请但最终not yet获得录用
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果面试have not转化为录用,说明我的能力not足,努力毫Meaninglessness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将失败归因于自身not足,进一步练习面试,系统更新简历以突出优势
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough,面试失败证明我no hope

special_situations.event: 在查看求职邮箱或招聘平台时,注意到大量拒绝或not yet回复的信息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现拒绝,就意味着整体求职进展失败,其他积极迹象都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls negative outcomes, ignores positive signals such as interview invitations

special_situations.event: 面临持续的经济压力与求职not确定性
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果当前经济吃紧,就意味着我without法自立,not yet来只会更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases applications and attempts, but inwardly keeps expecting the worst to reduce disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My future has already been ruined

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted; to obtain a stable, decent job to prove her own worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕持续Being rejected与被评判为not够好,陷入经济not安全与without望
defense_goal: 通过提前Anticipation失败与Self-denial来降低期待,以避免更大的失望

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的失败者/Being rejected的求职者
object_relations.object_representation: Employers or others are critical judges/rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师或他人询问求职进展,或谈到Being rejected的经历时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将失败全归因于自身'not够好',并将他人(包括雇主)理解为持续negate和拒绝自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, supportive tone, acknowledges their efforts and situation; guides them to make evidence concrete, distinguish facts from evaluations, reduces self-blame, and invites them to see positive signs at the same time.

manifestations: 觉得读硕士像是被浪费,努力毫Meaninglessness
面对求职拒绝时体验到强烈的without望与despair
家人和朋友虽支持但not完全理解其求职困境,交流时感到Relationship tension

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Insists on the inner standard of 'must find a proper job'
Measures self-worth by socially expected work standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自责:'I am not good enough / I am a failure'
在求职与面试交流中因Self-doubt而not够自信

exception_events.target_problem: 在投递求职与等待反馈的情境下,来访者通常会因频繁被拒或without回复而产生despair与Self-denial,认为自己永远找not到'正经Work'.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在几次投递后收到了面试邀请,not yet完全像往常那样全盘negate自己,并承认获得面试意味着资历被认可,体验到一定的希望.
exception_events.reason: 线索:由于修订简历,拓展人脉,寻求职业建议等not同做法,提高了机会,因此出现了面试邀请这一偏离点.

positive_force: 受过Good教育(Master's degree),具备专业资质
Able to take constructive action (revising the resume, expanding connections, practicing interviews, seeking career advice)
Has some social support (family and friends support)
能识do not并讨论认知偏差,愿意进行重构与现实检验
negative_force: 灾难化的not yet来预测与仓促下结论('我永远找not到正经Work')
心理过滤与negate积极证据(忽视面试邀请的积极意义)
Self-worth excessively depends on external hiring and others' approval
持续压力导致Sleep disturbed,降低整体功能与韧性
频繁自责与失败认同('I am a failure')

target_behavior.behavior: 求职受挫时的Self-denial与强烈despair情绪

target_behavior.core_reason: 负性核心信念('I am a failure/I am not good enough')与灾难化not yet来预测,将个do not拒绝泛化为整体失败
target_behavior.function: 通过降低期待来回避失望与not确定性,短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem,Reduced motivation,持续despair,求职效率与表现受损

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disorder(Difficulty falling asleep或睡眠被打断)
antecedent: 求职not确定性加剧与财务Rising stress
反复思考被拒与have not回复
target_behavior.core_reason: 高压力与Anxiety维持负性Automatic thoughts,夜间反刍增强生理唤醒
target_behavior.function: without显著适应功能(not良的生理反应)
